rules.title: Faces with the instant or sorcery card type
rules.implements: smtg:InstantOrSorceryFace owl:equivalentClass ( smtg:CardFace and (smtg:hasCardType some smtg:InstantOrSorceryCardType) )

rules.title: Layout-defined classes (ModalDoubleFacedCard, AdventurerCard, …)
rules.implements: every smtg:X owl:equivalentClass ( smtg:OracleCard and (smtg:hasLayout value L) ) recorded as L smtg:definedClass X

rules.title: Faces with a permanent card type
rules.implements: smtg:PermanentFace owl:equivalentClass ( smtg:CardFace and (smtg:hasCardType some smtg:PermanentCardType) )

rules.title: Hybrid and Phyrexian mana symbols
rules.implements: smtg:HybridManaSymbol ≡ ManaSymbol and (isHybrid value true); smtg:PhyrexianManaSymbol ≡ ManaSymbol and (isPhyrexian value true)

rules.title: Tokens a card can create (projection of all_parts)
rules.implements: smtg:createsToken — projection of smtg:PartRelationship with smtg:partRole part-component/token

rules.title: Mana a card can produce through a token it creates
Permanent cards (CR 110.4a): primary face is a permanent face, or a split card with a permanent half
rules.implements: smtg:PermanentCard owl:equivalentClass ( smtg:OracleCard and ((smtg:primaryFace some smtg:PermanentFace) or (smtg:hasLayout value layout/split and smtg:hasFace some smtg:PermanentFace)) )
